responsibility: This file implements runtime module dependency registration and initialization ordering for GNU Modula-2 in mc-boot. It maintains module records and state-specific circular chains, accepts module registration with init/fini hooks and dependency procedures, resolves and optionally forces ordering across modules and libraries, then drives construction and reverse-order destruction of modules around the application entry, providing the dependency scheduler that M2RTS delegates to for dynamic module startup and shutdown.
same_name_distinction: Implements the dependency scheduler declared in GM2Dependent.h by maintaining module-chain records and state lists, resolving and forcing ordering, and invoking init/fini callbacks in construction and reverse destruction order.
